name: Staghelm Point
summary: In northeastern Silithus, Staghelm Point keeps watch over the desert and Twilight's Run. Its ancient night elf tower looks over encroaching dunes, while old threats linger in nearby caverns.

sections.title: A Silent Watch Above the Sands
sections.body: Staghelm Point rises above the dry flats of northeastern Silithus. A lone night elf tower keeps watch over the wasteland, with cultists in nearby caves such as Twilight's Run. Ralo'shan the Eternal Watcher guards the outpost, and a bronze drake circles overhead. The tower bears the Staghelm name, recalling the great sacrifices the Kaldorei made during the ancient War of the Shifting Sands.

faq.answer: Ralo'shan the Eternal Watcher guards the tower. A bronze drake from the Brood of Nozdormu patrols the skies above.
Twilight's Run lies down the path from the peak. The cavern and its surrounding camp hold fanatical members of the Twilight's Hammer cult.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can remember the sacrifices the Kaldorei made during the War of the Shifting Sands to hold back the horrors beneath Silithus.
As a druid, you can look across Silithus's dry, corrupted wilderness from the tower bearing the Staghelm name. Nature's balance has been broken there.
